candidates.evidence: G 1579, 2D 2690 (single Lorentzian, FWHM ~32 cm-1), I2D/IG ≈ 3, with D 1344 and D' ~1623

The 2D width of 32 cm-1 is somewhat broad for a pristine monolayer (~25-30), and the 2D line is not clearly split. Defects or inhomogeneity can broaden it, so I can't fully exclude a decoupled bilayer.
The D/G ratio is moderate, but the G and D widths (~14-15) are narrow and the 2D line is strong, which does not fit amorphised carbon.

peaks.assignment: D band (defect-activated breathing mode, TO near K, double resonance)
peaks.source: Lorentzian fit; assignment per Ferrari & Basko 2013; Ferrari 2006 PRL 97 187401

peaks.assignment: G band (in-plane E2g zone-centre optical phonon)

peaks.source: Lorentzian fit; Cançado 2011 Nano Lett 11 3190; Eckmann 2012 Nano Lett 12 3925

peaks.assignment: 2D (G') overtone of D, two-phonon double resonance

properties.name: layers
properties.value: 1 (monolayer most likely); I2D/IG ≈ 3 by height, single symmetric 2D peak

properties.name: defect_level
properties.source: ID/IG ≈ 0.49 by height and 0.52 by area; D and D' are both clearly present

properties.name: L_D_nm
properties.value: ~17 nm (rough, ±30%). From L_D^2 = 1.8e-9·λ^4·(IG/ID) with λ = 532 nm, IG/ID ≈ 1.9-2.0. This is point-like defect spacing and sits at the edge of the validity range (Stage 1, L_D ≳ 10 nm).
properties.source: Cançado et al. 2011 Nano Lett 11 3190; Lucchese 2010 Carbon 48 1592

properties.name: defect_type
properties.value: mostly vacancy-like / lattice point defects. ID/ID' ≈ 6.3 (about 7 for vacancies, about 13 for sp3 and about 3.5 for boundaries). Boundaries or sp3 contributions can't be excluded.

properties.name: doping_type
properties.value: none / weak (G at 1579, 2D at 2690). The G position is close to the undoped value, and the G width of 14 cm-1 is only slightly broadened.
properties.source: Das 2008 Nat Nanotechnol 3 210; Lee 2012 Nat Commun 3 1024

properties.name: strain_sign
properties.source: Without a G/2D correlation analysis against a reference, strain and doping are degenerate.

citations: Ferrari et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 97, 187401 (2006)
limits: The spectrum covers 1100-3000 cm-1 only. The Si 520.7 cm-1 substrate line and the 2D' (~3240) and D+D'' regions are not covered. The Si 2TO band at ~950-980 sits outside the window, so substrate lines are not reported.
The window ends at ~3000 cm-1 and the D+D' combination near 2930 is weak against a sloping baseline, so I did not report it.

The L_D value is a rough estimate from a single-spot intensity ratio. It uses the 532 nm calibration and assumes Stage 1 (point-like) disorder. It shifts if peak areas rather than heights are used, and it is unreliable if the defects are mainly edges or boundaries.
The defect type rests on ID/ID' ≈ 6.3. That sits between the vacancy and sp3 reference values and carries a large uncertainty (it depends on the baseline, and D' is weak and sits close to G).
Layer number is judged from I2D/IG and the 2D lineshape alone. A decoupled (turbostratic) few-layer stack can't be fully excluded. Strain and doping can't be separated without a reference.
No polarization data are available, so I assigned no polarization pattern.
I found no clear cosmic-ray spikes by peak finding. The isolated sharp features were noise-level and are not reported.
